goodsServices.description: Optical guidance systems; aircraft landing aid systems; electronic controllers; lighting controls; lighting control apparatus; lighting control panels; LED lighting controls for maritime vessel deck lighting, aircraft landing aid systems, and general illumination purposes in military and extreme environmental settings; beacon lights; emergency warning lights; signalling lights; environmental monitoring system; meters and sensors for measuring pressure, humidity and temperature; ultrasonic sensors; electronic proximity sensors and switches; sensors for determining position, velocity and acceleration; electric and electronic sensors for measuring marine vessel speed; speed measuring instruments; meteorological instruments; anodes; electronic displays and computer displays for use in military and extreme environmental settings; cabinets, enclosures and cases for electronic communications systems, electronic displays, computer displays, weapons control systems, and computer hardware, for use in military and extreme environmental settings; electronic control and communication consoles for maritime vessels; electronic systems for maritime vessel hull signature management and corrosion protection .

Custom manufacture of electronic cabinets, enclosures, control systems and electronic assemblies to customer specification for use in military and extreme environmental settings.
